study_question: Can selected Light F2 and exact provisional D3 carry Production Lifecycle Utilities while keeping infrastructure deliberately secondary to ordinary creative work and preserving navigation-versus-effect boundaries?
must_preserve: utilities remain deliberate application/Production secondary scope rather than a permanent creative home
opening a utility surface != Production/provider mutation
provider/capability unavailable != Character refusal or fictional failure
diagnostics and recovery stay outside fiction
provider machinery != Character identity or Performer assignment
Close/Back restores retained creative origin when valid and != Undo
falsification: D3 makes utilities feel like a privileged admin/control center or visually outrank the originating creative task.
Darkness itself implies technical severity, provider authority, configuration effectiveness or diagnostic importance.
Teal/accent implies applied settings, provider health, portability success, recovery success or severity.
Utility families become permanent navigation equal to Home/Shaping/current situation.
Visual treatment suggests literal Product-dependent commands or a frozen portable/provider/recovery workflow.
D3 muddies retained creative origin or navigation-versus-mutation boundaries.
non_authority: No final utility labels, menu placement, dialogs, commands or confirmation behavior are created.
No portable Production format, merge/overwrite compatibility behavior or destinations are frozen.
No provider/model/cost policy, authentication, assignment, availability or Performer semantics are created.
No diagnostic, repair, fallback, recovery or destructive-action semantics are frozen.
No Production token freeze, semantic infrastructure colors, native implementation, Stage successor or Phase-3 convergence authority is created.
D3 remains provisional even if this local study passes.
next: Materialize the exact accepted Production Lifecycle Utilities carrier in selected Light F2 plus exact provisional D3, run the frozen seven-condition matrix, and audit secondary-scope hierarchy and navigation-versus-effect honesty before preservation.
